# Test evaluate_plans_memoized
env = PointEnv(length=200, goal_x=2, goal_y=0, goal_radius=1)
plans = np.array([
    [0, 0],  # Stay at origin - should get 0 reward
    [0, 1],  # Stay, then move right - should get 1 reward  
    [1, 1],  # Move right twice - should get 2 reward
])

print("Testing evaluate_plans_memoized:")
rewards = env.evaluate_plans_memoized(plans)
print(f"Plans: {plans}")
print(f"Rewards: {rewards}")

# Verify each plan manually
for i, plan in enumerate(plans):
    env_test = PointEnv(length=200, goal_x=2, goal_y=0, goal_radius=1)
    total_reward = 0
    for action in plan:
        reward = env_test.step(action)
        total_reward += reward
    print(f"Plan {i}: manual calculation = {total_reward}, memoized = {rewards[i]}")
